'''Oil of Garlic''' is a [[Crafting#Edible Items|drinkable crafted item]]. The recipe is earned at [[Combat]] skill level 6. The [[Dwarf]] also sells Oil of Garlic for {{Price|3000}} each.

Drinking Oil of Garlic gives the [[Buffs#Oil of Garlic|Oil of Garlic Buff]] which lasts for 10 minutes (real-time). The Oil of Garlic Buff prevents enemies from spawning in [[The Mines]], except on [[The Mines#Dungeon Floors|Dungeon Floors]].<ref name="monsterspawn"/> In [[Skull Cavern]], it prevents floors from being [[The Mines#Infested Floors|infested]], which does not include [[Skull Cavern#Prehistoric Floors|Prehistoric Floors]]<ref name="floorinfested"/>, and also prevents [[The Mines#Swarms|swarms]] of monsters on any level<ref name="swarmspawn"/>. The Buff has no effect in [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Dangerous Mines]] or [[Quests#Skull Cavern Invasion|Dangerous Skull Cavern]].<ref name="excludedangerous"/>

It is a special-effect buff, meaning that drinking Oil of Garlic will not remove any buffs from other drinks, or vice-versa.

'''Note''': this recipe is profitable - it will always result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.

==Tailoring==
Oil of Garlic can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Dark Highlight Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt263a.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Oil of Garlic is not used in any [[quests]].
